data.action: 独自靠住淋浴湿墙，一脚踩低凳，一手撑墙、一手随水流在腿间自抚，湿衬衫敞开
data.description: 成年德克萨斯独自在私人淋浴间靠住湿墙，一脚踩上低凳。湿白色府绸衬衫半透明敞开，她一手撑墙、一手循水流探向腿间，黑色狼尾在身后避开双腿，琥珀眼睛于雾气里保持克制。
data.lighting: 顶灯柔光穿过磨砂隔扇和水雾，深色石板与低凳上的水滴反光
data.location: 现代豪华浴室磨砂玻璃淋浴房
data.promptProse: A side-on view through the open edge of a frosted shower partition keeps the stone floor and the low teak stool in frame. Texas braces one hand against the tile and touches herself with the other, one foot on a low shower bench; her tail stays behind her, clear of both legs. The wet white poplin shirt falls open in heavy folds, its hidden button placket catching the drops under the ceiling light. A dull reflection runs along the dark slate beneath her planted foot. The chrome shower head and the frosted glass give the room a clear edge through the steam.
data.title: 德克萨斯 · 浴室水汽中的炽热贴合
data.animaCaption: Her near foot stays planted on the wet tiles and the other foot rests flat on the low stool. She braces a hand on the shower wall as her black tail hangs behind her in the mist.
